incidents.name: [Bug] Settings panel causes session timeout unexpectedly
incidents.description:
Summary: File upload handler returns incorrect results.

Steps:
- Filter results by date range.
- the application throws an unhandled exception.

Impact: Affects all users in the affected module. Workaround: Use the legacy interface as a temporary measure.

incidents.name: Issue in Payment module — displays stale data after refresh
incidents.description:
Summary: Settings panel throws 500 on empty input.

Steps:
- Enter a value exceeding 255 characters.
- the UI becomes unresponsive.

Impact: Causes data inconsistency in reports. Workaround: Clear browser cache and cookies.

incidents.name: Email integration breaks pagination logic (Enhancement)
incidents.description:
Reproducible on Chrome 119. Steps to reproduce:
1. Navigate to Audit log viewer.
2. Upload a file larger than 10 MB.
3. Observe that the user is redirected to an unexpected page.

Expected: The operation should complete successfully with a confirmation message.
Actual: The page goes blank with no error message.

incidents.name: Issue: causes session timeout unexpectedly when using Search module
incidents.description:
This issue was identified during exploratory testing.

Component: Email integration
Severity: Low

Description:
the system logs an error but shows success to the user. This occurs consistently when trigger a concurrent api request. The data should be persisted and reflected immediately.

incidents.name: [Enhancement] Settings panel does not validate input correctly
incidents.description:
This enhancement was identified during exploratory testing.

Component: API gateway
Severity: Medium

Description:
the application throws an unhandled exception. This occurs consistently when switch between user roles. The API should return HTTP 200 with the correct payload.

incidents.name: Bug: Reporting engine causes session timeout unexpectedly
incidents.description:
Reproducible on Chrome 120. Steps to reproduce:
1. Navigate to Login page.
2. Submit the form with an empty required field.
3. Observe that duplicate entries appear in the list.

Expected: The user should remain on the current page.
Actual: An HTTP 500 error is returned instead.

incidents.name: Authentication service fails on concurrent requests (Enhancement)
incidents.description:
Summary: Login page ignores user permissions.

Steps:
- Navigate away and return to the page.
- the data is not saved correctly.

Impact: Degrades performance for concurrent users. Workaround: Refresh the page and retry.

incidents.name: Dashboard returns incorrect results (Enhancement)
incidents.description:
This enhancement was identified during integration testing.

Component: User profile
Severity: Medium

Description:
the page displays a blank screen. This occurs consistently when filter results by date range. The API should return HTTP 200 with the correct payload.

incidents.name: [Issue] Admin console causes session timeout unexpectedly
incidents.description:
This issue was identified during exploratory testing.

Component: Payment module
Severity: Low

Description:
the user is redirected to an unexpected page. This occurs consistently when switch between user roles. The data should be persisted and reflected immediately.

incidents.name: Authentication service returns incorrect results (Enhancement)
incidents.description:
Summary: User profile returns incorrect results.

Steps:
- Export data to CSV format.
- the UI becomes unresponsive.

Impact: Affects all users in the affected module. Workaround: Perform the operation in smaller batches.

risks.name: Potential block release timeline in Search indexer
risks.description:
There is a risk that Third-party integration could expose sensitive data.

This was identified during sprint planning review.
Likelihood increases when a dependent service becomes unresponsive.

Recommended action: Schedule periodic security audits

risks.name: Risk: Database cluster may exceed budget thresholds
risks.description:
Risk identified for Load balancer.

Scenario: Load balancer may exceed capacity limits under certain conditions.

Potential impact: Data loss or corruption requiring manual recovery
Mitigation: Introduce circuit breakers and graceful degradation

risks.name: Potential miss SLA targets in Email delivery service
risks.description:
Summary: Database cluster — potential to fail silently.

Context: third-party API changes its contract.
Consequence: Service disruption affecting all end users.
Proposed mitigation: Conduct regular load testing.

risks.name: API gateway — expose sensitive data risk
risks.description:
Risk identified for Email delivery service.

Scenario: Email delivery service may fail silently under certain conditions.

Potential impact: Revenue loss due to downtime
Mitigation: Allocate buffer in the release timeline

risks.name: Risk: Logging infrastructure may expose sensitive data
risks.description:
There is a risk that Monitoring stack could fail silently.

This was identified during operational readiness review.
Likelihood increases when configuration changes are deployed without review.

Recommended action: Introduce circuit breakers and graceful degradation
